# Ragù Italian Bistro

> Authentic Neapolitan restaurant at 5–7 Guildhall Street, Preston, PR1 3NU, United Kingdom. Run by chef Vincenzo Gaglione and Luca Scognamiglio, both from Naples, open since 15 March 2026. Cuisine: Neapolitan/Italian. Price range: ££. Phone: +44 7922 958745. Opening hours: every day 12:00–20:00, Friday and Saturday until 21:00. Food hygiene rating: Very Good.

## Menus
- [À la carte](https://ragu-italian-bistrot.netlify.app/assets/menu-a-la-carte.pdf): Antipasti, pizza, pasta, secondi and dolci — the full Neapolitan repertoire.
- [Lunch](https://ragu-italian-bistrot.netlify.app/assets/menu-lunch.pdf): A shorter, quicker menu for the middle of the day.
- [Cocktail](https://ragu-italian-bistrot.netlify.app/assets/menu-cocktail.pdf): Aperitivo and after-dinner drinks.
- [Kids](https://ragu-italian-bistrot.netlify.app/assets/menu-kids.pdf): Smaller plates for younger guests.
